data.text/markdown:
k-means over the F3 embedding

The embedding from examples/seismic/scripts/seismic.py maps each seismic trace to three numbers. Here those numbers are clustered at several k, and each labelling is drawn back onto the survey: one colour per cluster, one cell per 25 m bin. Clusters of the embedding group traces whose lateral neighbourhoods look alike, so coherent colour patches are geology the operator considers similar — salt bodies, the channel system, fault blocks — not noise, because neighbouring traces feed each other's embedding. The cache is written by the training script, so nothing here retrains: 
uv run python examples/seismic/scripts/seismic.py    # writes f3_embedding.npz
uv run marimo edit examples/seismic/notebooks/clusters.py

data.text/html: Balances

Spatial coherence

Share of horizontally adjacent trace pairs landing in the same cluster, against the chance rate 1/k. Above chance means neighbouring traces cluster together.
